relationships.subject: Zerumbone
relationships.evidence_quote: The pre-treatment with CB1 receptor antagonist (SR141716, 1 mg/kg) prior to zerumbone (10 mg/kg) abolished both the anti-allodynic and antihyperalgesic effects typically observed in the chronic constriction injury animal model of neuropathic pain.

relationships.subject: Zerumbone
relationships.evidence_quote: Based on the present findings, zerumbone utilizes PPARα to exert both its anti-allodynic and antihyperalgesic effects.

relationships.subject: Zerumbone
relationships.evidence_quote: The current findings indicate that PPARγ is involved in zerumbone's anti-allodynic effect and not its antihyperalgesic effect.

relationships.subject: Zerumbone
relationships.evidence_quote: The anti-allodynic effect of zerumbone was significantly reversed (p < 0.0001) in both the G64+Z and G96+Z groups.

key_findings: Zerumbone's anti-allodynia involves CB1, PPARα and PPARγ; anti-hyperalgesia involves CB1 and PPARα but not CB2 or PPARγ
Docking shows favourable binding of zerumbone to CB and PPAR receptors
